formulas.morale_pressure: casualty_pressure + commander_loss_pressure + positional_pressure + isolation_pressure + supply_pressure + fear_pressure - rally - cohesion_support

input_rules.recent_casualty_fraction: 0..1; casualties suffered during current shock window divided by personnel present at window start
input_rules.cumulative_casualty_fraction: 0..1; total unresolved casualties since formation entered current engagement divided by engagement-start personnel
input_rules.commander_lost: 0 or 1 for current unresolved command-loss shock
input_rules.deputy_lost: 0 or 1 for current unresolved deputy-loss shock
input_rules.registered_fear_pressure: numeric points from effects already registered before the engagement; unregistered narrative fear adds 0

resolution_rules.rout_or_surrender_choice: use saved doctrine, escape geometry, command state, and surrender legality; if multiple equally legal outcomes remain, use recorded deterministic RNG
